why: the user asked to see how the feet slip. This renders the same simulation that produces the reported numbers; no motion is added, no pose is scripted, no root is overwritten.
what_is_rendered: the stand-pose full-42-joint PPO controller (experiments/banc-stand-retarget, MODEL_stand.npz) run for 1 s of measured-target assist followed by 3 s of autonomous control, rendered at 50 fps from two cameras (wide follow view and a low close-up of the feet on the textured floor)
what_is_measured: per 5 ms tick: per-leg force-weighted tangential contact speed, per-leg slip ratio against the release-phase forward speed, forward speed, COM height, foot loads, and the phase label; written to SLIP_TRACE.json so every number in the video is checkable
visualisation_only_changes: camera follows the fly (lookat = thorax XY)
tendon and actuator debug drawing disabled
foot geoms tinted so the contact points are visible
not_changed: physics: gravity, contacts, friction, actuators, timesteps
labelling: the run uses the declared adhesion channel (grip on); it is a derived-channel result, not frozen-body acceptance. A second video repeats the same run with grip off for comparison.
accounting: physics steps counted and reported; the video frame count equals the sampled ticks
